module:compaction-settings.settings.openchamber.defaults.compaction: OpenCode summarizes a session on its own as it nears the model's context limit, and once more when a provider rejects a request as too long. When off, only /compact compacts, and a session that reaches the limit stops with an error.
Applies to every project. A project whose own OpenCode config sets these keeps its own values.
The share of the model's context window kept free. Compaction starts once the rest fills up, so 20% compacts at 80% full. By default OpenCode keeps 15% free, at least 16K.
How much of the latest conversation stays word for word beside the summary after compaction. More keeps exact recent details but leaves less room for new work.

Experimental OpenCode feature. As a session nears compaction, OpenCode writes the summary ahead of time and swaps it in when compaction is due, so the session doesn't pause for it. A summary that ends up unused still costs tokens. Sessions under about 64K tokens skip it.
